listSubtitle: Curate past sessions into distilled memory stores. Each Dream lets a dreamer agent read filtered session history and write a curated memory store.
listEmpty: No dreams yet. Create one to curate past sessions into a memory store.
listCancelDialogMessage: Cancel "{{name}}"? The dreamer session will be terminated and no output store will be produced.
detailNoFilters: No filters — the dreamer curates every past session (capped at {{limit}}).
detailCancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel this dream? The dreamer session will be terminated and no output store will be produced.
createSubtitle: Launch a dreamer agent that reads past sessions and writes a curated memory store. Dreams are a v0.7.0 research preview.
createInputStoreHint: The store the dreamer agent reads source memories from.
createOutputNameHint: The dreamer agent creates this store in the workspace. Must not match an existing store name.
createDreamerAgentHint: Overrides LINCHPIN_DREAMER_AGENT_ID for this run. Required if no default dreamer is configured.
createSessionFilterHint: Restrict which past sessions the dreamer curates. All set fields are combined; leave everything empty to curate every session (capped at 100).
createSinceUntilError: "Since" must be earlier than or equal to "Until".
createLimitError: Session limit must be an integer between 1 and 100.
createNameConflict: A memory store named "{{name}}" already exists. Choose a different output name.
createDreamerNotConfigured: No dreamer agent is configured. Select a dreamer agent explicitly or set LINCHPIN_DREAMER_AGENT_ID.
